summary.what_changed: Google I/O moved from leak-weather to ship: Gemini 3.5 Flash is out, Search upgrades to agent mode, and Sundar says Gemini Omni video output is rolling out today via the Gemini app + Flow. Separately: Andrej Karpathy joined Anthropic — a talent move straight into pretraining.
summary.trust_posture: Primary-heavy: Google blog posts + CEO tape + Karpathy’s own post. No new benchmark claims without audited public cells; rankings stay rolling-state until leaderboards ingest 3.5 Flash / Omni.
summary.priority_lane: Frontier release velocity + product embedding (Search) + frontier talent (pretraining).

sp_index.verdict: I/O landed as product reality, not just rumor: a new Flash family for agentic workflows + Search-as-agent surface. Omni is the bigger frontier bet, but it’s a rollout story until public demos + cells arrive. Karpathy to Anthropic is the other kind of curve-move: pretraining talent consolidation.

loop_dispatch.headline: Google shipped. Anthropic hired. The curve split into two kinds of motion.
loop_dispatch.dek: Gemini 3.5 Flash is out and Search becomes agent-shaped; Omni starts rolling as video output. Then Karpathy walks into Anthropic pretraining. One day, two curve levers.

runs.text: Google I/O moved from leak-weather to ship.
Gemini 3.5 Flash
is the headline: a new Flash family positioned for agentic workflows, plus a developer/enterprise tool stack. On the product side,
Search’s I/O update
frames this as the start of “Search agents,” with Gemini 3.5 Flash set as the default model in AI Mode. The broader surface is collected on the
I/O announcement page
Omni is the bigger bet, but today it’s a rollout story. Sundar says
Gemini Omni video output is rolling out today
via the Gemini app + Flow, with YouTube Shorts this week — and the official I/O collection repeats the same framing.
Gemini 3.5’s own post
is explicit about agentic workflows; treat Omni as distribution-first until audited cells arrive.
Second lever: pretraining talent.
Karpathy posted he’s joined Anthropic
. The Reddit thread is already a useful read on how the ecosystem interprets the move (hype vs. signal), but the only load-bearing fact is the post itself.
Reddit discussion
Net: today’s curve moved in two ways at once — product embedding (
Search agents
) and frontier R&D staffing (
Karpathy → Anthropic
). Tomorrow morning’s job is to collapse this into one clean curve read: did Flash/Omni show up on public leaderboards, and did Search-agents land as real automation or just a demo scaffold?

loop_dispatch.closing_line: Next trigger: audited public cells for 3.5 Flash/Omni — and a Search-agent workflow that runs unattended for hours, not minutes.

news.title: Gemini 3.5 ships: Flash is positioned as the agentic coding workhorse
news.summary: Google announced Gemini 3.5, framing it as “frontier intelligence with action.” Flash is the first release in the family, with the post explicitly positioning it for agentic workflows and coding at Flash-speed latency.
news.why_it_matters: Release velocity matters when it lands as usable product surface. Flash is not yet a benchmark move until audited cells land, but it is a distribution + tooling move that can compound quickly.
news.verdict: Material ship. Treat capability claims as queued until public evaluations ingest the model.
news.evidence: Google’s own model announcement (primary) + I/O collection page for the broader launch surface.
news.tap_next: Watch for first public leaderboard ingestion (LMArena / AA / SWE-bench third-party) and any Omni-to-Flash cross-over claims with raw cells.

news.title: Gemini Omni rollout starts with video outputs via Gemini app + Flow
news.summary: Sundar says Gemini Omni combines world understanding and multimodality and begins rolling out today starting with video outputs, via the Gemini app + Flow, with YouTube Shorts this week.
news.why_it_matters: If Omni is real and widely usable, it’s a curve event (multimodal generation + editing at scale). Today is the start of distribution; the next step is reproducible demos + independent evaluation.
news.verdict: Material rollout signal; treat as distribution-first until audited cells exist.
news.tap_next: Watch for public access tiers, promptability limits, and first third-party quality comparisons vs existing video models.

news.title: Search becomes agent-shaped: AI Mode upgrades to Gemini 3.5 Flash + “information agents”
news.summary: Google frames I/O 2026 Search as the start of “Search agents,” with Gemini 3.5 Flash as the default model in AI Mode and agent-like background updates for topics you care about.
news.why_it_matters: Agents only matter when they persist and act. If Search agents become a reliable background watcher + action surface, that’s a real autonomy-horizon proxy for the mass market.
news.verdict: Distribution wedge. Watch for persistence, tool access, and failure modes.
news.tap_next: Watch for: background agent limits (time horizon), action scope (tool calls), and whether this actually reduces manual search labor.

news.title: Karpathy joins Anthropic
news.summary: Andrej Karpathy announced he has joined Anthropic and is returning to frontier R&D work. This is a rare talent move directly into a top lab’s training pipeline.
news.why_it_matters: Compute and capital are visible constraints. Talent is the hidden limiter. A single high-leverage researcher can bend the next pretraining run’s slope.
news.verdict: Material talent consolidation for Anthropic. Watch what ships downstream.
news.tap_next: Watch for any Anthropic release / paper / training note that reflects the new pretraining push.

benchmark_panel.section_headline: New ships today; audited cells will lag. Keep the board honest.
benchmark_panel.section_summary: Gemini 3.5 Flash and Omni are material releases, but this board stays on audited, source-linked ranking surfaces until leaderboards ingest the new models. The only safe move on ship-day is to say what changed, then wait for cells.
